mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market acceleration that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls by >0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand and housing market strength, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising (current value > 3-month moving average), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO above 1.5% YoY) indicates easing supply constraints and improving corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 1.5%, or the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% YoY signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% MoM) indicates a robust labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating consumer demand (RSAFS growth above 0.3% MoM) improves corporate revenue outlook, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days in the regime of expanding consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS MoM growth exceeds 0.3%, or the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production growth (INDPRO rising) and unemployment decline (UNRATE falling) signal strong economic expansion with improving supply capacity and labor conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising and UNRATE is falling (current value > 3-month moving average for INDPRO and current value < 3-month moving average for UNRATE), or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.
